text: After failing to save a patient, the nurse Katie, now a devout Catholic calling herself Maud, takes a job in an English seaside town caring for Amanda, [a dying former dancer who fears the oblivion of death|who_suffers|the old, sick and dying]. Maud comes to believe [God has tasked her with saving Amanda's soul|origin|a mind turning on itself], and in prayer the two seem overcome with ecstasy. When Amanda's party guests [laugh at her and call her Saint Maud|trigger|being spurned or shamed], Maud waits for a sign, and binds [a spugna to her foot to mortify the flesh|images|holy and occult objects].
